text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the race, Tokyo Racecourse is buzzing with an incredible level of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In one corner is the Umamusume who defeated the Eternal Top Three. In the other, the legendary Umamusume whose return no one expected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, they're about to go head to head in a 2,400-meter G1 showdown on Tokyo turf—the same conditions as the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup—Sakura Chiyono O and Maruzensky's personal Derby—is about to begin.
